semantics.alias_rule: q Editor binds q surfaces to stable logical backend aliases.
semantics.provider_rule: Provider/model binding belongs to backend configuration, not UI control identity.
semantics.queue_rule: q/qc/qt queue semantics remain Runtime Queue Profile semantics.
semantics.test_rule: Configuration tests are bounded explicit backend calls and do not become permanent authority/config unless saved.
semantics.authority_rule: Backend configuration changes are explicitly authorized.
semantics.response_rule: Backend test response is inert and cannot modify configuration by itself.

invariants.rule: Expose components reuse canonical semantics and remain non-privileged projection/composition surfaces.
